name: Echeross
source:
Games nowadays are a huge waste of time and can't be played comfortably; If you're busy and wants a game that can be finished in a short time, then this one is for you.

Play and finish together in a short time, the action and story are all light. Easy! Very Easy? An action game for you!!!!!

Sister [url=/c4148]Seto Aiko[/url] suddenly stoods in front of the main character [url=/c70364]Agisawa Ryuuto[/url] and makes him do her part/favor of defeating the alien parasite invading the female human brain. He initially refused but agreed with her after being lectured by the said sister not only on how to fight but also more like this.

Many people think on fighting games when it comes to an 1v1 action genre. But Echeross, unlike other fighting games, rather than being a complex input, it's an operation method where special moves are done by any input like a simple or mashed button press, a directional combination with button mashing or a double button combination.

Controls (NOTE: All attacks are projectiles but they become neutral while getting close):
Arrow keys - Move your character;
Z - Basic attack;
X - Special attack.
translation:
如今的游戏太浪费时间，也无法让人轻松游玩。如果你工作繁忙，又想玩一款能够迅速通关的游戏，那么本作正适合你。

短时间内开始并完成游戏，动作与故事都十分轻量。简单！非常简单？献给你的动作游戏！！！！！

姐姐[url=/c4148]濑户爱子[/url]突然出现在主人公[url=/c70364]阿木泽龙斗[/url]面前，要求他替自己消灭正在侵入女性人脑的外星寄生虫。龙斗起初拒绝，但姐姐不只向他讲解战斗方式，还进行了更多训导，最终令他答应协助。

提到一对一动作游戏，许多人会想到格斗游戏。但《Echeross》不同于其他格斗游戏，它没有复杂输入；玩家只需简单按键或连打、方向组合加连打，或两个按键组合，就能施放特殊招式。

操作方式（注意：所有攻击均为投射物，但距离拉近时会变成普通攻击）：
方向键——移动角色；
Z——普通攻击；
X——特殊攻击。
